key.name: park-left
key.summary: Park windows at the left screen edge

key.name: park-right
key.summary: Park windows at the right screen edge

key.name: park-top
key.summary: Park windows at the top screen edge (below the top bar)

key.name: park-bottom
key.summary: Park windows at the bottom screen edge

key.name: patch-overview
key.summary: Show parked windows as tiles in the overview and workspace switches
key.description: Changes GNOME's overview and workspace-switch animations so parked windows don't pop up at full size. Turn off if a GNOME update breaks them.

key.name: zone-percent
key.summary: Edge zone width, in percent of the screen width
key.description: How close to an enabled screen edge the pointer must come for a dragged window to shrink, and to park when dropped.

key.name: stash-left
key.summary: Stash windows at the left screen edge
key.description: A window dragged toward the edge shrinks once its own edge comes within glance-zone-percent of it, down to glance-smallest-percent, as in Glance for KDE. Dropped there it stays as small as it is drawn (a stash); where parking is on too, dropped with the pointer in the edge zone (zone-percent), or at tile size, it parks.

key.name: stash-right
key.summary: Stash windows at the right screen edge

key.name: stash-top
key.summary: Stash windows at the top screen edge

key.name: stash-bottom
key.summary: Stash windows at the bottom screen edge

key.name: glance-dragging
key.summary: Obsolete: stashing at every parking edge
key.description: Replaced by stash-left, stash-right, stash-top and stash-bottom; turned into them once, then reset.

key.name: glance-zone-percent
key.summary: Stashing: where shrinking starts, in percent of the screen width (height for the top and bottom) from an edge

key.name: scatter-stashes
key.summary: Stashing: shaking a window (and Super+double-clicking the desktop) stashes the other windows instead of parking them
key.description: As in Glance: they go into a column at each side where stashing is on, beside its tiles, at one common scale.

key.name: glance-smallest-percent
key.summary: Stashing: the smallest a dragged window gets before the edge zone, in percent of its full size
